description: This file defines the ResetCodeController class which handles resetting password codes within an OrangeHRM authentication plugin. It includes methods for rendering relevant components based on the validity of the reset code.

classes.name: ResetCodeController
classes.description: Controller class for handling password reset code validation and page rendering in the OrangeHRM authentication plugin.

methods.name: getResetPasswordService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the ResetPasswordService instance used for validating reset codes.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component based on the validity of the reset code, setting up appropriate Vue components for displaying reset password form or error message.
